data.notes: February 2026 in Verbier/Val de Bagnes leaned toward alpine après-ski, carnival brass/DJ culture, and a few classical/family music-programming highlights rather than large standalone music festivals.

events.title: Requiem de Verdi
events.summary: Ensemble Vocal de Martigny and the Symphonistes d’Octodure performed Giuseppe Verdi’s Requiem at Eglise du Châble, with solists Franziska Heinzen, Sonja Leutwyler, Sascha Kramer and Patrice Berger.

events.title: Reverence Fiesta with Chris Liebing and NikoBeats
events.summary: A ticketed house and techno night in Verbier featuring Chris Liebing and NikoBeats, with the main party listed from 21:00 to 02:00 at Rabbit Hutch.

events.title: Vollèges Carnival
events.summary: A Val de Bagnes carnival event with guggen bands, floats and a DJ, centred on Salle du Casino in Vollèges and listed from 13 to 15 February 2026.

events.title: Aperitif and concert of the Guggen de Bagnes
events.summary: Verbier Tourisme hosted a free aperitif and concert by the Guggen from Bagnes, Chenegouga, on Place Centrale from 17:00 to 18:00.

events.title: Peter & The Wolf / The Magic Piano
events.summary: Verbier Festival KiDS presented a family screening of two music-led animated films: Peter and the Wolf and The Magic Piano, the latter featuring Chopin music performed by Lang Lang.

events.title: Ski et Son Bruson
events.summary: Bruson staged a one-day ski-and-music event with musical entertainment across the resort and a festive on-slope atmosphere from 09:00 to 22:00.
